text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] us-east-1a - elevated inference 5xx rate and TCP resets from backend nodes. detection: error_rate > 5% for 3m, tcp_reset_rate spike. docs: https://internal.metrics/redwood/alerts/17234 :rotating_light:
oncall-emma: Acked. I'm on it, paging SRE and infra. will confirm scope and customer impact.
sre-jay: Looking at NLB metrics — TargetHealthCount unhealthy increasing from 2 -> 12 in last 6m. EC2 instance-level `tcp_retransmits` and `rx drop` up. quick snippet: `aws cloudwatch get-metric-statistics --metric-name NetworkPacketsIn --namespace AWS/EC2 ...`
infra-maya: I see ENI detach/attach retries for a subset of g5 instances in us-east-1a. Kernel rx queue counters show drops on a few hosts. collecting `ethtool -S` and dmesg.
oncall-emma: Runbook step 1: mark nodes draining in us-east-1a and scale up us-east-1b pool. Executing:```./infractl drain --zone us-east-1a --selector inference=hot```
eng-runtime-lee: Suggest enabling model-variant fallback for the next 30m to reduce retries. Patch request router config:```route -> prefer(us-east-1b) else fallback(gpt-q8) retry=2 backoff=200ms```This reduces token fanout while steer completes.
support-raj: Notifying customers: two paying customers (acct-9921, acct-7783) report 10-20% 5xx on inference calls. SLAs showing latency SLO breach at 95th. I opened tickets #INC-1298 and #INC-1299.
sre-jay: After initiating drain + steer (t+7m), error rate dropped from 12% -> 1.8% in us-east-1 traffic subset. NLB unhealthy count decreasing. P95 latency improving. attaching short log sample:```[2026-03-17T14:11:03Z] conn reset from 10.0.32.45:443 - ECONNRESET```
infra-maya: AWS support case opened (case-id: 2087654321). AWS indicates brief fabric-level packet loss in us-east-1a affecting ENIs. They're correlating with internal maintenance event. Collecting tcpdump on affected hosts for AWS support.
oncall-emma: Customer comm: support-raj, please send interim update that we've steered traffic and errors are mitigated; we'll follow up with RCA within 24h.
eng-runtime-lee: We've applied the fallback routing and temporarily reduced max concurrent streams to 70% for clients hitting 5xx to reduce amplification. Monitor configured alerts at 15s cadence.
sre-jay: Metrics now: overall cluster errors normalized. Posting grafana panels: https://internal.grafana/redwood/d/abc123/us-east-1a-inference — p95 back to baseline, errors -> <2%.
infra-maya: Continuing host-level forensic collection; will keep case open with AWS until they confirm root cause. snapshotting instance console logs and kernel traces.
oncall-emma: Handoff to night oncall @oncall-nick for follow-up. Assigned owners: infra-maya (for AWS follow-up), eng-runtime-lee (for routing/fallback revert plan), support-raj (customer comms). Severity downgraded to Sev3; monitoring for recurrence. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident record created: https://incidents.redwood/internal/INC-20260317-001
support-raj: Sent interim updates to acct-9921 and acct-7783, ETA RCA 24h. asking for priority callbacks if they see regressions.
oncall-emma: Closing active mitigation — traffic fully shifted and autoscaler adjusted. Leaving playbook tasks for owners. Thanks everyone. :handshake:
